boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations in Siena’s practical Loudonville/Capital Region orbit, each paired with one documented reason to go.

cards.title: The Works Café for a bagel
cards.subtitle: Loudon Road corridor — 594 Loudon Rd., Latham
cards.notes: Use the Loudon Road stop for a bagel or breakfast; Siena specifically points visitors to The Works Café as a nearby food option.
cards.short_summary: A named café stop on the Route 9/Loudon Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena’s Capital Region guide suggests grabbing a bagel at The Works Café; The Works lists its Latham location at 594 Loudon Road.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold; check the café’s page for current daily service details.

cards.title: Stewart’s for coffee
cards.subtitle: Loudon Road corridor — 605 Loudon Rd., Latham
cards.notes: Make this Route 9 stop when you want coffee, a quick food item, or ice cream from a regional convenience-store chain.
cards.short_summary: A practical coffee-and-snack stop along Loudon Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena recommends getting coffee at a Stewart’s Shop, and Stewart’s lists a Loudon Road shop at 605 Loudon Road in Latham.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; confirm the individual shop’s current hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: Saati Deli for lunch
cards.subtitle: Loudon Road corridor — Loudonville
cards.notes: Plan a lunch stop at Saati Deli, one of the specific nearby lunch options named by Siena’s Capital Region visitor guide.
cards.short_summary: A named deli stop in Siena’s nearby Route 9 area.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena’s Capital Region guide recommends having lunch at Saati Deli.
cards.source_title: Siena University — New York’s Capital Region
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; verify current ordering and service information directly with the deli.

cards.title: Midpoint for dinner
cards.subtitle: Loudon Road corridor — Loudonville/Latham area
cards.notes: Use this named restaurant as a dinner option when planning an off-campus meal with family, classmates, or visitors.
cards.short_summary: A Siena-listed restaurant stop in the nearby Route 9 area.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena’s Capital Region guide suggests having dinner with family at Midpoint.
cards.source_title: Siena University — New York’s Capital Region
cards.access_notes: A meal requires a purchase; confirm current service details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Newton Plaza to browse
cards.subtitle: New Loudon Road/Route 9 corridor — 584–594 New Loudon Rd., Latham
cards.notes: Browse the named shops at Newton Plaza, a Route 9 retail destination Siena identifies for visitors exploring nearby Loudonville.
cards.short_summary: A multi-store browsing stop on the New Loudon Road stretch of Route 9.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena recommends browsing the shops in Newton Plaza; CDTA lists Newton Plaza at 584–594 New Loudon Road in Latham.
cards.source_title: Capital District Transportation Authority — Shopping Centers
cards.access_notes: Individual tenant hours and purchase requirements vary; check a tenant directly before visiting.

cards.title: The Crossings for a picnic
cards.subtitle: Albany Shaker Road corridor — Loudonville
cards.notes: Bring a picnic to this named Loudonville park; Siena lists it as a nearby outdoor option in its Capital Region guide.
cards.short_summary: A documented park-and-picnic destination on Albany Shaker Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena’s Capital Region guide suggests having a picnic at the Crossings of Colonie.
cards.source_title: Siena University — New York’s Capital Region
cards.access_notes: Follow posted park rules and verify seasonal conditions or facility availability before heading over.

cards.title: Sanford Library to study
cards.subtitle: Albany Shaker Road corridor — 629 Albany Shaker Rd., Loudonville
cards.notes: Use the library’s accessible building and public collections for a focused study stop away from campus; bring your library card if needed.
cards.short_summary: A full-service public library on the Albany Shaker Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The William K. Sanford Town Library describes itself as a full-service public library at 629 Albany Shaker Road and lists public hours.
cards.source_title: William K. Sanford Town Library — About Us
cards.access_notes: The library lists regular hours, with seasonal Sunday changes; check its site before visiting.

cards.title: Colonie Center for a film
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue/Wolf Road corridor — 1417 Central Ave., Albany
cards.notes: Use this enclosed shopping center for its documented Regal digital cinema, then plan the rest of the visit around individual tenant hours.
cards.short_summary: A cinema-and-retail destination at the Central Avenue and Wolf Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Colonie Center’s official site identifies the center as a shopping, dining, and entertainment destination and names its 13-screen Regal digital cinema.
cards.access_notes: Film tickets and concessions require purchase; cinema and store schedules vary by tenant.

cards.title: Dave & Buster’s to play arcade games
cards.subtitle: Crossgates Mall Road corridor — 1 Crossgates Mall Rd., Albany
cards.notes: Choose the arcade side of this all-ages entertainment venue for games; purchase a Power Card at the front desk before playing.
cards.short_summary: A named arcade destination on the Crossgates Mall Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Dave & Buster’s lists its Albany venue at 1 Crossgates Mall Road and describes the location as an arcade; it also states parties are for all ages.
cards.access_notes: Use the arcade and food-service areas; game play requires a Power Card and current hours are listed by the venue.

cards.title: Latham Farms for a retail stop
cards.subtitle: Troy Schenectady Road corridor — 579 Troy Schenectady Rd., Latham
cards.notes: Use this named shopping-center stop when you need a Route 7/Troy Schenectady Road errand; plan around the particular tenant you need.
cards.short_summary: A named shopping-center destination on Troy Schenectady Road.
cards.evidence_claim: CDTA lists Latham Farms as a shopping center at 579 Troy Schenectady Road in Latham.
cards.source_title: Capital District Transportation Authority — Shopping Centers
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours and purchase requirements.
